$description:
Density — the third axis, and the most healthcare-specific token group in the system.

  patient    roomy, larger targets, patient-facing surfaces
  standard   general SaaS and admin
  clinical   dense worklists, flowsheets, results tables

Set with `data-zb-density` on any container. Components read these rather than hard-coding spacing.

Density is a contract, not a preference. The same component serves a patient reading on a phone and a nurse scanning ninety rows, and the difference between those is spacing and target size — never which clinical facts appear. Hiding a fact to save a row is a defect, not a density mode.

density.$description: Every profile defines the same keys. A profile missing one is a build error, for the same reason a theme missing a status colour is: the fallback would be silent and wrong.

duration.$description: Unhurried. A patient reading their own care plan should not feel rushed through it.

target.$description: Holds at 24px even in dense mode — the WCAG 2.2 AA target-size floor. Below this, mis-taps become clinically consequential. Dense means tighter rows, not smaller buttons.

duration.$description: A dense worklist must not feel slow. Motion duration belongs to density for the same reason spacing does: the same component serves a nurse scanning ninety rows and a patient reading one screen, and the difference between them is pace.

density-target-floor.$description: The absolute floor, independent of profile. DensityTarget clamps against this so a custom density profile cannot drop a hit area below the accessible minimum by accident.
